title: About
text:
I hold a B.Tech in Mathematics and Computing from IIT Hyderabad, and I’m learning LLMs and agentic AI in public. This site collects my notes and articles, each paired with a YouTube video.
The series follows The Hitchhiker’s Guide to Agentic AI by Haggai Roitman (CC BY-SA 4.0). Articles are self-contained, intuition first, and each one lists what I changed from the book.
